# Dr Sachin G R, Neurosurgeon

> Official website of Dr Sachin G R, MS, MCh (Neurosurgery), a senior consultant neurosurgeon with over 15 years of experience in brain and spine surgery. Trained at PGIMER Chandigarh, with a skull base fellowship in Osaka (Japan), an endoscopic spine surgery fellowship in South Korea and paediatric neurosurgery training at SickKids, Toronto.

Appointments and second opinions: phone or WhatsApp +91 99142 08940. Content on this site is general patient education, not medical advice.
